sloka: सौम्य राम निरीक्षस्व सौम्येन वदनेन माम् ।कुबेरभवनात्प्राप्तं विद्धि मां पुष्पकं प्रभो ।। ७.४१.३ ॥
transliteration: saumya rāma nirīkṣasva saumyena vadanena mām ।kuberabhavanātprāptaṁ viddhi māṁ puṣpakaṁ prabho ।। 7.41.3 ॥

translations.english: O gentle Rama, look at me with a gentle face; know me, O Lord, to be the Pushpaka chariot that has arrived from Kubera's abode.
